author: Little Chinese Everywhere
description:
Every year, thousands of people make a pilgrimage across Fujian to Meizhou Island, the birthplace of Mazu — the goddess of the sea and one of the most important figures in coastal Chinese folk religion.
What makes the pilgrimage so fascinating isn’t just the destination, but everything that happens along the way: incense-filled temples, processions through villages, prayers, fireworks, and communities coming together to honor a tradition that has been passed down for centuries.
A glimpse into one of China’s most deeply rooted living traditions 🇨🇳
title: Did you know there is a pilgrimage in China? #pilgrimage #china #fujian
